content: पण्डित {%a.%} [पण्डा तारका˚ इतच्] .²1 Learned, wise; स्वस्थे को वा न पण्डितः. .²2 Shrewd, clever. .²3 Skilled in, proficient, skilful (generally with <ab>loc.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>); मधुरालापनिसर्गपण्डिताम् <ls>Ku. 4. 16</ls>; so रतिपण्डित <ls n="Ku.">4. 18</ls>; नयपण्डित <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-तः@} .²1 A scholar, learned man, {%Paṇdita%}. .²2 Incense. .²3 An adept, expert.
